name: Verificar Tenant

parameters.query:
SELECT
  u.id            AS "userId",
  u.name          AS "userName",
  u.subscription_status AS "subscriptionStatus",
  u.plan          AS "plan",
  -- Facebook token (encrypted AES-256)
  fb.access_token AS "fb_token_encrypted",
  fb.page_id      AS "fb_page_id",
  fb.is_active    AS "fb_active",
  fb.token_expires_at AS "fb_expires_at",
  -- Instagram token
  ig.access_token AS "ig_token_encrypted",
  ig.ig_user_id   AS "ig_user_id",
  ig.is_active    AS "ig_active",
  -- LinkedIn token
  li.access_token AS "li_token_encrypted",
  li.li_person_id AS "li_person_id",
  li.is_active    AS "li_active",
  li.token_expires_at AS "li_expires_at"
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN user_social_accounts fb
  ON u.id = fb.user_id AND fb.platform = 'facebook'
LEFT JOIN user_social_accounts ig
  ON u.id = ig.user_id AND ig.platform = 'instagram'
LEFT JOIN user_social_accounts li
  ON u.id = li.user_id AND li.platform = 'linkedin'
WHERE u.wa_id = '{{ $json.waId }}'
LIMIT 1;

notes: Ejecutar inmediatamente después de parsear el mensaje entrante. Si retorna 0 filas → tenant no registrado. Si retorna 1 fila → usar subscriptionStatus para el Switch.
